• Bangladesh's largest dental chain with 4 branches (Mirpur, Uttara, Badda, Jatrabari) — high patient volume across locations with no unified booking system
• Appointment intake is 'Request a Free Callback' form + phone (09638-000505) — no real-time slot confirmation, patients wait for callback

I build AI agents that fix exactly this. For a business like yours, I'd start with an AI appointment agent that answers treatment enquiries with instant price guidance, books patients into real-time slots at the right branch, and sends recall reminders so no patient is lost.

I've already built a working demo — happy to show you in 15 minutes. No commitment, just want to show you what it does.
